verdict.rationale: Snowsight's Query History page lets you monitor queries from the last 14 days and drill into a query profile that shows each step of an executed query. That covers the core of diagnosing slow queries. A community comment says per-query cost attribution and built-in recommendations are lacking, which weakens the 'expensive' half of the story but does not contradict the profiling capability. Missing for 10: evidence of EXPLAIN or textual execution-plan output, per-query cost or credit attribution, operator-level detail (e.g. spilling, pruning statistics), and independent hands-on corroboration.
